answer: A karst challenge-chain bond stops fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits, then walks three links: an orchard stamp, a karst stamp, a raven perch stamp, each key-signed within ten minutes. A raven auditor replays the chain; a missed link, reused stamp, or a rented-chain ring burns the bond. First link 35, the kth 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 35 once, keeps the bond.
